title: A proof for the conjecture on superlinear problems with Ambrosetti-Rabinowitz condition
summary: This paper is devoted to exploring a new minimax approach by introducing a characteristic mapping family which is invariant under the smooth descending flow for initial value. The minimax approach is self-contained, and its features are markedly different from standard ones, as it identifies the existence of critical points and intrinsically presents a lower-bound estimate for the generalized Morse index at the corresponding critical point.
